args.description: Pixel Heaven native pixel art. Slightly overhead 3/4 RPG view, orthogonal ground (not isometric diamond), upper-left light, crisp 1px clusters, selective dark outlines, warm muted limited palette. Transparent background, no text, no watermark, no scene or ground platform, entire silhouette inside canvas. Home swordsman: short steel sword in RIGHT hand and broad round shield in LEFT, sage green cloth, round shield emblem, silver helmet and light armor. Full body facing south. Native 32x48, visible adult height 40 pixels, top 8 pixels empty, feet at bottom ground anchor (16,48), no enlarged chibi head. Modest practical clothing. Use only combat_v1 colors: #2E342F #454C43 #E9DDC6 #CBBDA2 #BAC4C1 #7B9299 #4D626B #7F9B86 #526F61 #65899A #B46F55 #784C40 #D6A078 #9285A7 #665D7A #DEC58B #AF9254 #896849 #5D4D3B #9A9B88 #676F63 #D1A382 #9A6E52 #4C433E

revision.description: Redraw this same swordsman at native32x48 pixels with taller adult body filling40px HEIGHT, head at y8 and BOOT SOLES at y47. Keep sword RIGHT hand, shield LEFT hand, same armor and sage cloth. Remove excessive empty space BELOW boots. Draw extra native anatomical detail, do not upscale existing pixels. Transparent background, no ground.

postProcessing: Uniform pivot-centred lossless packing; no body scaling.
Mapped RGB to combat_v1 nearest colors without dithering; alpha unchanged.
Hit generated as four frames (API minimum), selected 0,1,3 to deliver three.
Constant direction-specific vertical translation from idle foot to declared pivot, applied unchanged to every frame; offsets in frames.json. No per-frame crop or scale.
referenceRightsBasis: Original textual descriptions, no third-party reference image uploaded.
